name: geohod-quests-platform
description: GeoQuest monorepo — Rust (Axum) backend + Next.js (React 19) frontend.

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.fmt:check: cd backend && cargo fmt -- --check && echo 'rust fmt ok'
scripts.clean: rm -rf frontend/.next frontend/node_modules root-node_modules || true; cd backend && cargo clean
